item.title: SCOTT BANKS JOINS THE REDS
item.description: Barnsley Football Club is delighted to announce the loan signing of winger Scott Banks, who joins the Reds from Bundesliga side FC St. Pauli until the end of the 2025/26 campaign, subject to international clearance. The 24-year-old arrives at Oakwell following a productive first half of the season on loan at Blackpool in Sky Bet League One, where he made 20 appearances and scored five goals while impressing in multiple attacking roles. item.description: Barnsley’s newest recruit, Scott Banks, says he’s “excited to get going” after completing a loan move to Oakwell until the end of the season.
